It traversed all 17225 nonempty Hasse covers and a Kahn topological sort visited all 4215 faces, proving exact acyclicity. Separately propagated integer incidence signs through all 1236 needed degree-3 gradient elimination states: every one of the 51x15 integral Morse differential entries vanishes. Independent direct GF2 boundary elimination returned ranks (24,201,699,850,275,25) in degrees 1..6. The Morse CW 3-skeleton is a wedge of 51 S^3 (no 1/2 cells) and its 15 4-cell attaching maps have zero classes in π3 ≅ H3 by Hurewicz, hence are null; the claimed integral wedge follows. This finite exhaustive certificate covers precisely this 25-vertex torus, not other sizes; archived VERIFY_OK alone is not used as proof.

value.rationale: The 5x5 periodic triangular hard-hexagon graph is a natural small two-dimensional frustrated fermion lattice already studied with exactly 66 rational ground-state classes. Those known ranks, especially in adjacent homological degrees 3 and 4, leave a genuine unstable integral homotopy ambiguity: 4-cell maps into a wedge of 3-spheres are not determined by rational ranks alone. A complete explicit acyclic Morse matching and integral zero attaching map resolve that exact natural finite invariant, yielding the full non-equivariant homotopy type and excluding torsion/other attachments for this specific physically motivated torus. The exact fact can be needed as a benchmark for larger triangular tori and further symmetry studies without pretending to solve an infinite-lattice problem. It is not merely recomputation of Huijse numbers or a renamed hard-square theorem.
